export_quantized_model: export a DiffQuantizer quantized model to a TorchScript file at the given path
recompress_torchscript_file: recompress a saved TorchScript zip file to reduce size by compressing zeroed weights
unpack_param_torchscript: unpack packed DiffQ quantized weights back to FP32 tensors during TorchScript forward pass
codegen_quantizer: generate Python source code for a DiffQuantizer to create a TorchScript-compatible wrapper class
get_full_name_access: convert a dotted parameter name into proper attribute access syntax with bracket indexing for lists
